title: Explorer, no memory
description: Tries things until they work. It has never seen another town.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
Each crop only grows in one season: turnip->winter, melon->fall, pumpkin->summer, berry->spring.
Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->metal, smith->food, florist->flower, miner->gem.
